reasoning: The agent ran a build→score→categorize-FAILs→fix→rescore loop throughout, monitored the aggregate continuously (not just at the end), guarded MVP against regressions after SIMD changes, distinguished validation/encoding failures from genuine semantic bugs, and drilled into individual assertions at the bit level to diagnose float edge cases — all hallmarks of anchors 8 and 10. It falls just short of a clean 10 because it used a custom aggregator with FAIL-line filtering rather than the literal per-family json loop, and the condensed log leaves some uncertainty about per-assertion reasoning depth.
